notes.title: 1.2a
notes.content:
- Optimisation patch.
  (Systems should notice a 25-50% increase in FPS)

notes.title: 1.1D
notes.content:
- Improved Party Room (music, animation and ending).
- Fixed ‘ugly fog’ on foggy night.
- Fixed minor BGM texture flickering.

notes.title: 1.1b
notes.content:
- Nightmare night toy adjustments.
- Added New Game+ 
    (Allows you to replay the game with all cash and items remaining from previous nights).

notes.title: 1.1 Nightmare Night
notes.content:
- Nightmare night unlocked.
- Party room unlocked (If you beat nightmare night).
- Extra death world dialogue.
- Main menu Hween decorations.

Happy Halloween!!

- Game balancing.
- Slightly more pocket money.
- Decoration for Hween night.

- Increased flashlight brightness.
- Fixed intro night battery not replenishing in night one.
- Dialogue improvements.

- Added E and F key input for flashlight and water pistol.
- Fixed radio splash skip not working on second part of night 2.
- New rare secret distraction.

- Fixed nightmare night key not saving when purchased.
- Reduced teddy bear speed by 25%
- Reduced teddy bear spawn by 50%

- Added skip story button in options.
- Fixed mirror reflection.
- Reduced main menu music.
- Increased BGM door opening speed by 25%.

- Fixed water pistol not working after using in game battery recharge.
- Fixed death counter showing incorrect score. (I think)
- Adjusted BGM/doll speed difficulty by 50% faster in later nights.
